name: vertical profile irregularity
definition_zh: 轨道沿线路方向的竖向几何不平顺。
scope_note: 属于轨道不平顺的一种类型，与方向、水平和轨距不平顺区分。
usage_overview: 主要作为垂向几何激励，用于分析车体加速度、轮轨垂向力及其随机响应；在轨道检测中，通过谱、波长和时频特征识别长短波状态并评价几何质量。可分别描述左右轨，也可与水平不平顺共同构成分析输入。

complete_examples.text: Moreover, in some locations emphasized by the blue ellipses, the wheel–rail vertical force has a significant fluctuation, which reflects the impacts brought out by the interactions between track vertical profile irregularity and other factors.
From Table 1, one can observe that the wheel–rail vertical force is rather sensitive to the track vertical profile irregularity especially encountering with the detrimental wavelengths.
The track irregularities, for example, the track vertical profile irregularity and track alignment irregularities, are plotted in Figure 5.
And ηv, ηc, ηg, ηa are used to indicate the vertical profile irregularity, cross level irregularity, gauge irregularity and alignment irregularity of the track, respectively.
